build_lstm_forecast_model: build a python module to create an LSTMForecast PyTorch model with LSTM and Linear layers for time series
create_lstm_params: create an LSTMParams instance with hidden_size, time_window, and num_epochs for the LSTM model
fit_lstm_model: fit an LSTMModel on univariate time series data using Adam optimizer and MSE loss over epochs
predict_lstm_forecast: predict future time series steps using a fitted LSTMModel and return a DataFrame with forecasts
get_lstm_parameter_search_space: get the default parameter search space for hidden_size, time_window, and num_epochs for LSTM tuning
